top_signals.title: Treasuries Selloff Deepens as US-Iran Standoff Pushes Oil Higher
top_signals.summary: The selloff in the US bond market deepened on Monday as oil prices rose after President Donald Trump rejected Iran’s latest proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: Gold and silver prices fell sharply on Monday as rising bond yields tempered investor appetite for non-yielding precious metals.

top_signals.title: SpaceX Sends Starship to Orbit and Deploys 26 Starlink V3 Satellites
top_signals.summary: SpaceX's Starship reached orbit for the first time on Monday, Reuters reported, deploying 26 Starlink V3 satellites on the vehicle's 14th test flight after one of its six upper-stage engines failed roughly two and a half minutes into the mission. The Super Heavy booster ignited all 33 of its engines at 7:48 a.m. CT from SpaceX's Starbase facility near Brownsville, Texas, sending the 40-story vehicle over the Gulf of Mexico before Starship separated and continued alone toward orbit. top_signals.title: Activities of U.S. Affiliates of Foreign Multinational Enterprises, 2024
top_signals.summary: Majority-owned U.S. affiliates of foreign multinational enterprises employed 8.57 million workers in the United States in 2024, a 0.2 percent increase from 8.56 million workers in 2023, according to statistics on U.S. affiliate operations and finances released today by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis.
